title: Take it back
brief: You rewrote draft.txt and immediately regretted it. The last commit still holds the good version. Throw your edit away.

goals.label: draft.txt matches the last commit again
Still exactly one commit (nothing new committed)

diagnostics.say: draft.txt is still modified. Run git diff to see the damage, then git restore draft.txt to discard it.

hints: Run git diff to see exactly what you changed.
git restore draft.txt copies the committed version back over your edit.
